_comment: User-editable descriptions for Claude assets. Add a key matching the asset name or path, with a one-sentence description. These persist across scans and are used to generate MY_ASSETS.md.
ai-cost-tracker: Tracks and reports costs across AI API usage (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
cal-daily-report: Generates daily summary reports from Google Calendar events.
VS Temp folder: Temporary working folder for VS Code / Cursor experiments.
youtube_english_filter.py: Searches YouTube for English-language videos on a given topic using the Data API.
promptvault: Centralized hub and management system for all Claude-related assets.
